title: Quick Smoky Uruguayan Orange Skewers
description: A floral and shattering Uruguayan dish featuring orange, made vegan-friendly and perfect for meal prep. This recipe uses binchotan-charcoal for a smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan-charcoal grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the orange segments to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the orange segments onto skewers, leaving a small space between each segment.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until slightly charred.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Let the skewers cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for meal prep.
Reheat the skewers in the microwave or oven before serving.
Serve the skewers as a snack or side dish.
